main.summary: Defines the lifetime-owned notification wait handle used by persistent follow-session subscriptions.

method.name: WaitForWakeAsync
method.summary: Wait for the next wake hint observed by this persistent notification subscription handle.
method.param: Wait duration to apply to the notification wait. Positive values bound the wait, and waits until a wake, connection failure, disposal, or cancellation occurs.
method.returns: A task that completes with true when a wake hint is observed; otherwise false when the wait elapses without a wake.
